hints.title: Prefix Matching via Trie
hints.text: Store all word prefixes in a trie. For each starting index i in target, traverse the trie to find the maximum contiguous length that forms a valid prefix.

hints.title: Interval Reachability
hints.text: If at index i the longest valid prefix has length L, we can transition from index i to any index up to i + L.

hints.title: Jump Game Greedy Transition
hints.text: Convert this into Jump Game II: greedily track the farthest reachable boundary and increment jump count whenever reaching the current interval end.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Building trie takes O(W). For Version I with |target| <= 5000, checking trie takes O(|target|^2). Jump game takes O(|target|).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branch exploration without greedy jump game leads to exponential paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trie stores up to W nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines trie prefix exploration with Jump Game greedy interval advancement.
